title: Managed Database: external retention allocation applicability
content:
## Applicable business situation
Managed Database external retention allocation is governed by these scope conditions. This nonfinancial consolidated-account branch applies to complete UTC months in which the linked Managed Database and Managed Backup contracts were active throughout the month; the archived retained quantities are whole hundredths of a GB-month, so monthly capacity in GB is numerically the full-month GB-month allowance.
